patients.summary: Healthy graduate student who joined in 2023. In 2025 she had gonococcal PID with pharyngeal infection, then Fitz-Hugh-Curtis perihepatitis a month later, and in early 2026 a disseminated gonococcal infection treated in hospital; all resolved, retest negative in June 2026.

events.reason: New patient, establish care and annual exam

reports.text: Specimen: cervical, liquid-based preparation. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation; transformation zone component present. Interpretation: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
21 y/o woman new to us. Previously followed at a pediatric and adolescent office until she aged out; records requested. Just started a graduate program this month and wanted an adult doctor close to campus.

No ongoing health problems. No meds, no supplements. NKDA. No surgeries. Periods regular, monthly. Sexually active, condoms most of the time, no prior STI that she knows of. No pregnancies.

Family: mother with hypothyroidism found at 45; father with high blood pressure since his 50s. No autoimmune disease or unusual infections in the family.

Social: grad student, lives in an apartment with a roommate. Never smoked, no vaping. A drink or two on a weekend. No drug use.

ROS negative across systems.

Exam: well-appearing, vitals as charted. HEENT clear, neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. Skin without rash. Pelvic: normal external genitalia, cervix without lesions, Pap collected. Mood bright.

Assessment/plan:
- Adult preventive care. Pap today (first one, age 21). Urine GC/CT NAAT; HIV and hep C screens once.
- Discussed condoms with every partner and contraception choices; she will think it over and is not starting anything today.
- Flu vaccine given, L deltoid. She'll get the fall COVID booster at her pharmacy.
- PHQ-2 zero.
- Return in about a year, sooner by text or call.

documents.title: Results Message
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Juniper, your screening tests are all negative: gonorrhea, chlamydia, HIV and hepatitis C. The Pap goes to cytology and usually takes about a week; I'll send that one along too.

documents.title: Prior Pediatric Practice Records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: 38 pages from the prior pediatric/adolescent office. Contents: well-child and adolescent visits through 2021, growth charts, immunization record. No chronic diagnoses, no hospitalizations, no surgeries. Immunizations entered: MMR and varicella x2, Tdap 2013, MenACWY 2013 and 2018, HPV 9-valent two-dose series 2013-2014. Indexed to chart.

documents.title: Pap Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your Pap came back normal. Next one in three years, so fall of 2026. Your old records also came in, and your vaccines are all up to date, including HPV.

documents.title: Pharmacy Immunization Record
documents.author: MA
documents.body: State registry shows 2023-2024 COVID-19 vaccine given at a community pharmacy 10/11/2023. Entered in immunization history.

documents.title: Form Request
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my program needs an immunization form signed before I can start my clinic placement in March. Can you fill it out? I uploaded their PDF. Thanks!

documents.title: Form Completed
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Your immunization form is signed and uploaded to your messages. The original is also being mailed to your apartment.

documents.title: Appointment Cancelled
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt texted she has a midterm that morning. Cancelled and moved to 10/10 at 2:00.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly exam. Second year of her program, placement went fine. Feels well. Sleeping okay most weeks, busy but not overwhelmed. Still on no meds. Sexually active; condoms usually, she says. No new symptoms, no pelvic pain or discharge. Cycles regular.

PHQ-9: 2.

Exam: comfortable, vitals as recorded. Ears and throat clear. No adenopathy. Heart: regular, no murmur. Lungs: clear bilaterally. Abdomen benign. Skin clear. Affect normal.

Plan:
- Yearly GC/CT urine screen sent.
- Flu shot today.
- Pap not due until 2026.
- COVID booster at the pharmacy when convenient.
- Next physical in a year.

documents.title: Results Message
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Juniper, your gonorrhea and chlamydia screen from Thursday was negative. Nothing else pending.
